boundary: The current simulator supplies a scalar susceptibility rotation-curve audit only. It does not supply a tensor field, a mapping from that field to an observed two-dimensional galaxy quantity, or a tensor likelihood.

recoverable_public_source.name: SPARC Galaxy Rotation Curve database
recoverable_public_source.role: Scalar rotation-curve benchmark only; it cannot by itself validate a tensor-morphology prediction.

required_before_prediction: Define the FPM tensor quantity and its units or dimensionless normalization.
Define a single physical observable that is linearly or nonlinearly mapped from that tensor.
Choose a public two-dimensional data product with a stable identifier and preserve its orientation, point-spread function, masks, and covariance.
Freeze a galaxy-selection rule and a train/calibration versus held-out split before fitting any orientation or source parameters.
Publish the prediction map, likelihood, baseline model, nuisance parameters, and rejection criterion before inspecting the held-out maps.
prohibited_interpretation: Do not call a scalar SPARC RMSE result a tensor-galaxy result.
